llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create a route in the stack and present it as a modal screen (for example via native-stack `presentation` modal option).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Compose screen is registered in the stack without any `presentation: 'modal'` or equivalent option. The createNativeStackNavigator config only lists `screens: { Notes: NotesScreen, Compose: ComposeScreen }` with no screen-level options.
evidence: const Stack = createNativeStackNavigator({ id: 'root', screens: { Notes: NotesScreen, Compose: ComposeScreen } });

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Cancel action in compose must dismiss back to notes (for example with `navigation.goBack()`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleCancel calls navigation.goBack(), which dismisses back to Notes.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Save action in compose must add the drafted note to shared notes state/context and then dismiss back to notes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleSave calls addNote (shared context) with the drafted text and then navigation.goBack().

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Stack is created via createNativeStackNavigator with a static config object, and Navigation is produced by createStaticNavigation(Stack), then rendered as <Navigation />.
